scope: Honor the selected icon material for Dock roles, Downloads and secondary file managers.
approval: Maintainer requested publication for every color after reviewing the red Dock previews.

checks.command: Generated all 6,359 icon names for red in both appearances and checked their aliases, image dimensions and tint coverage.
Compared alpha coverage of 1,394 unique sources with both generated red variants.
Rendered 24 representative Dock icons for all eight installer accent presets in both appearances. Verified that only empty and full Trash remain identical across accents.
Captured and reviewed the tinted Dock in both icon appearances in an isolated KDE neon Wayland guest with macOS Dock role artwork enabled.

coverage_limits: The desktop captures show the red preset on KDE neon. Other accents were checked against generated artwork. Golden Gate consumes the same pinned implementation.
